1704-4493-5195-7063.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-4493-5195-7063.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication, Krark, any additional copies of Krark, and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color..
Resolve a Krark trigger, flipping a coin and returning the Irenicus's Vile Duplication card to your hand if you lose and copying it if you win.
If you copy Irenicus's Vile Duplication, Storm-Kiln Artist triggers again, causing you to repeat steps 3 to 4.
Repeat steps 5—6 for each Krark trigger.
If Irenicus's Vile Duplication is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Irenicus's Vile Duplication card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Ember Island Production, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Irenicus's Vile Duplication and Ember Island Production end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

1170-2499-3389-5954-8345.description:

When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

206-751-3286.description:

Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.

Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.

1651-4231-4321-4732-5261.description:

Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

338-3197-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.

Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent

3165-3532-3835-5078.description:

997-2866-4708-4986.description:

3951-5703-5744-6798.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.

3951-5703-5744-6798.description:

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.

Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Approach of the Second Sun copy, causing you to gain 7 life.

Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
